sources_considered.why: Readable reporting documents customer backlash and several distinct causes.

evidence_items.locator: Opening section, paragraph beginning Marketing professionals
evidence_items.explanation: The report supports the customer-disappointment component after GPT-5. It also identifies removed models, broken workflows and routing problems, so the backlash cannot all be assigned to inflated capability expectations.

The CTO's account connects dissatisfaction to expectations, especially continuity and reliable workflows. It does not establish disappointment among investors or trace the expectations to the marketing alleged in the post.

An OpenAI investor publicly expressed continued confidence after the GPT-5 rollout. This does not rule out disappointment with a particular release, but cautions against inferring general investor disillusionment from customer backlash.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved evidence establishes substantial disappointment among OpenAI investors caused by unmet expectations for a later GPT release.
The causal contribution of the alleged marketing is not separated from rollout problems and product changes.
There is no deadline at which continued investor or customer satisfaction would defeat the forecast.
